name: Gmail (Google)
summary: Sign-in is instant. Send-only is a sensitive scope (about 10 business days of review). Reading mail is restricted: Google verification plus an annual third-party CASA security assessment, around 6+ weeks. Until then you're capped at 100 test users whose tokens expire every 7 days.

composio.note: Composio-managed Gmail skips verification and CASA for you. Users see “Composio” on the consent screen, not your app. Bring your own once you want your own brand there.

steps.title: Create a Google Cloud project and enable the Gmail API
steps.detail: One project per environment. Enable the Gmail and/or Calendar API, or calls fail with “API has not been used in project”.
steps.agent: Write the gcloud commands and enable the APIs
steps.human: Sign in and create the project

steps.title: Configure branding, audience and data access
steps.detail: External user type. Add an app name, logo, support email, authorized domains and privacy policy URL. List the exact scopes.
steps.agent: Draft the privacy policy, including Google's Limited Use disclosure
steps.human: Publish it on your verified domain

steps.title: Create the OAuth client (Web)
steps.detail: Credentials → Create OAuth client → Web application. Add redirect URIs (Composio BYO: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback).
steps.agent: Add the exact redirect URIs and test the flow in Testing mode

steps.title: Verify domain ownership in Search Console
steps.detail: Every authorized domain on the consent screen must be verified by a project Owner or Editor.
steps.human: Add it at your DNS provider

steps.title: Submit for brand verification
steps.detail: Google checks the name, logo, domains and homepage. About 2–3 business days.
steps.agent: Pre-check the homepage, privacy link and logo against the requirements

steps.title: Record the scope-justification demo video
steps.detail: An unlisted YouTube video showing the OAuth flow with the client ID visible, and how each scope is used.
steps.agent: Write the shot list and the justification text for each scope
steps.human: Record the screen and upload it

steps.title: Sensitive/restricted scope verification
steps.detail: Sensitive: about 10 business days. Restricted: about 6 weeks including the security assessment.
steps.human: Submit and respond within the reply window

steps.title: CASA security assessment (restricted scopes)
steps.detail: A Google-empanelled assessor tests your app against the CASA (OWASP ASVS-based) framework. You get a Letter of Validation, and you redo it every 12 months.
steps.agent: Run the self-scan and fix findings; assemble the evidence pack
steps.human: Pick an assessor, pay any fee, sign off
steps.cost: Assessor fees vary; some tiers are free or low-cost

alternatives.label: Send replies with gmail.send instead of saving drafts
alternatives.tradeoff: Users can't review a draft before it goes out.

alternatives.label: Build a Gmail add-on that reads only the open email
alternatives.tradeoff: No background triage: the agent sees a message only while the user has it open.

facts.claim: gmail.readonly, gmail.compose and gmail.metadata are restricted scopes
facts.title: Google: Choose Gmail API scopes
facts.quote: Restricted scopes Scope code Description https://mail.google.com/ Read, compose, send, and permanently delete all your email from Gmail. Note: Request this scope only if your application needs to immediately and permanently delete threads and messages, bypassing the trash. You can perform all other actions using less permissive scopes. https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly View your email messages and settings. https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.compose Manage drafts and send emails. https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.insert Add emails into your Gmail mailbox. https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.modify Read, compose, and send emails from your Gmail account. This scope does not allow immediate, permanent deletion of threads and messages, bypassing the trash. https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.metadata View your email message metadata such as labels and headers, but not the email body.

facts.claim: Internal apps used only inside your Workspace organisation skip verification
facts.title: support.google.com/cloud/answer/7454865
facts.quote: Internal apps: if your app is an internal web app for users in the same G Suite domain and the app is associated with a Cloud Organization that all of your users belong to, you don't need to go through verification.

facts.claim: Unverified apps show a warning screen and are limited to 100 new users
facts.title: support.google.com/cloud/answer/7454865
facts.quote: If your app remains unverified, the unverified app screen will be displayed before the consent screen, and your app will be limited to 100 new users until it is verified.

facts.claim: The 100-user cap applies over the project's lifetime and cannot be reset
facts.title: Google Cloud Help: Verification FAQ (2–3 days / 10 days / 6 weeks)
facts.quote: Please note the user cap applies over the entire lifetime of the project, and it cannot be reset or changed.

launchToday: Composio-managed Gmail: real users today, with no verification on your side.
Or stay in Testing mode: up to 100 test users. Refresh tokens expire after 7 days, so plan for weekly reconnects.
Ship gmail.send (sensitive) or sign-in first. Add gmail.readonly once CASA is done.
Submit brand verification today. It takes 2–3 days and unblocks everything after it.
rejections: Requesting gmail.readonly or full mail access when gmail.send or metadata would do
The demo video doesn't show the consent screen with the client ID, or doesn't show each scope in use
Privacy policy missing the Limited Use disclosure, or not on the verified domain
Homepage doesn't explain the app, or sits behind a login
Requesting a new restricted scope later re-triggers review

blockers.problem: “Google hasn't verified this app” / app blocked
blockers.fix: Stay under 100 test users in Testing mode, or submit for verification. For Workspace customers, their admin can trust your app in the Admin console.
Testing-mode refresh tokens expire in 7 days. Publish to production (verification) or use Composio-managed auth.

blockers.problem: Verification email asks for more information
blockers.fix: Reply in the same thread, and change only what they asked for. Unrelated edits can restart review.

uncertain: CASA assessor cost varies by tier and assessor, and Google doesn't publish it.
Timelines are Google's estimates. Real waits vary with how many review rounds you need.
